project_info.theme: joyful adult snow angel in cozy winter fashion
project_info.color_palette: fresh white snow, dark chocolate, beige, cream, and soft gold

main_subject.description: A joyful adult woman with long wavy ash-blonde hair, laughing and looking up toward camera.

main_subject.pose: Lying on her back in fresh powder snow with arms and legs spread in a snow-angel shape.

composition_elements.framing: High-angle bird's-eye full-body portrait, centered in the snow angel impression.

lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: Warm, playful, old-money winter fashion, and celebratory.

technical_specs.quality: detailed snow crystals, realistic faux-fur texture, natural skin, clean sunlight

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 4:5 bird's-eye winter lifestyle portrait of a joyful adult woman lying in fresh powder snow and making a snow angel. She has long wavy ash-blonde hair, laughs while looking up at camera, and wears an oversized dark-chocolate faux-fur coat over a beige ribbed knit turtleneck and leggings, brown suede fur-trim boots, white cable-knit leg warmers, a cream fringe scarf, and delicate unbranded gold necklaces. Use bright natural winter sunlight, crisp snow texture, soft-edged shadows, realistic faux fur, and a warm cozy old-money winter-fashion mood. No text, logos, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, nudity, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, logo, watermark, readable text, plastic snow, distorted anatomy, extra limbs

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: All references are optional. Use them only to replace the adult winter outfit, snow texture, or sunlight direction.
